cross_cutting_mbo_finding: BUY-ABSORPTION-FAILING is the dominant read on 3 of my 4 days (0429/0505/0506): a large positive signed flow (buy aggressors, +7783/+3258/+2066) under a FALLING price = buyers being absorbed by resting supply and FAILING to lift. flow_conviction is NEGATIVE (sign(sflow)*sign(pxchg) < 0) in the decisive phases, and here that negative-under-falling resolves BEARISH (down-continuation), NOT as an accumulation turn. This is the mirror of the accumulation arm: the accumulation-arm turn (buy absorption -> turn UP) is a LIVE arm but it must actually FIRE (price turns); when the buy is absorbed and price keeps bleeding, the arm has NOT fired and the sign stays DOWN. The RTS-up projection on 0506 is exactly this failure mode.
